searches.title: Searches
searches.description: One search per line: product names, company names or certificate numbers (pick which below). Each line is searched on its own.

searchBy.title: Search by
searchBy.description: What the search lines are. Certificate numbers look like ID32110020463611024.

maxItems.title: Max products
maxItems.description: Stop after this many products in total. Broad words like "kopi" match hundreds of thousands of products.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max products per search
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Optional cap per line, so one broad search doesn't use the whole run.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Indonesian government sites often block non-Indonesian server IPs, so the default is Apify residential proxy in Indonesia (ID). Turn it off only if you run from an Indonesian IP.
